answer: The yarrow counter is kept in violet and ledge reveals each reset. Anyone therefore has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 39 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 39 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 3004 identities would post 1823 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
